suites.name: Suite 1: SSRF & Security Hardening
suites.description: Validates blocking of loopback, private RFC1918, CGNAT, link-local, cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), restricted ports (22, 25, 5432, 6379, 3000), internal hostnames, and redirect bounds.

suites.name: Suite 2: Concurrency & In-Flight Locking
suites.description: Verifies mutex lock preventing duplicate in-flight pipeline runs on the same project/batch (returns HTTP 409) and releases lock cleanly on completion.

suites.name: Suite 3: Database Transactions & Integrity
suites.description: Verifies Dexie atomic read-write batch transaction across 9 tables, idempotent re-writes, cascading delete with zero orphan records, and multi-tenant project isolation.

suites.name: Suite 4: Data Quality & Scoring Reliability
suites.description: Verifies deterministic scoring on 4 edge-case profiles, role-based decision maker taxonomy, and non-manipulation of lead scores.

suites.name: Suite 5: Partial Failure Isolation
suites.description: Injects DNS failures, SSRF blocked URLs, and missing websites to verify partial isolation, continued pipeline execution, and robust stage degradation.

suites.name: Suite 6: Scalability & Bounded Concurrency
suites.description: Measures latency, heap delta, and error rates across 10, 50, and 100 business batches with worker pool concurrency bounded to 4.
